quality_highlights.aspect: All three status messages are clear and precise. run-failure explicitly names 'detected missing tools' and surfaces {status} — the pattern other workflows should follow.
macOS runner error follows gold-standard pattern: problem statement → explanation → example → documentation link. Test file explicitly asserts all four properties.

single_file_improvements.issue: GitHub App-Only Permissions section: 20+ scope names as dense comma-separated text; 'These scopes must always be declared as read.' appears between Organization and User groups, creating ambiguity about which groups the constraint governs. Fix: move constraint note above Repository-level group as a blockquote; add brief parenthetical descriptions to group headers.

run-failure: 'Analysis interrupted!' — 'interrupted' implies external disruption not workflow failure; exclamation mark is tonally wrong on failure. Fix: 'Analysis failed. [{workflow_name}]({run_url}) did not complete: {status}'
